results.correct_value: Snow near the col usually provides water, but it is not year-round: it can be gone or rock-hard late in a dry season.
results.evidence: The row's approach, approach_variants hazard and camping card all say the col's snow is unreliable by late summer. Outside reports agree water near the col is limited or non-existent late summer/early fall, with one late-season party carrying 6 L each for lack of it and bench-camp threads pointing to the lower spring instead. One older description does say 'year round snow', so the sources are not unanimous; the patch removes the 'year-round' promise without asserting a new number.
